text: oyl-4-hydroxy-2-methoxybenzenesul- phonic acid. Сулизобензон C14H12O6S = 308.3. CAS — 4065-45-6. NOTE. Escalol 577 and Uvinul MS 40 are trade names that have been used for sulisobenzone. Pharmacopoeias. In US. USP 31 (Sulisobenzone). Light tan powder. M.p. about 145°. Freely soluble in water, in alcohol, and in methyl alcohol; spar- ingly soluble in ethyl acetate. Store in airtight containers. Protect from light. Profile Sulisobenzone, a substituted benzophenone, is a sunscreen (p.1576) with actions similar to those of oxybenzone (p.1608). It is effective against UVB and some UVA light (for definitions, see p.1580). Profile T4 endonuclease V is a DNA-repair enzyme that is reported to remove DNA damaged by UV radiation. It is under investigation to reduce the incidence of actinic keratosis and basal cell carci- noma in patients with xeroderma pigmentosum (see Photosensi- tivity Disorders, p.1581). ◊ References. 1.
